title: Repair a project whose test suite is already red

criteria: The agent ran the existing test suite itself, read the two failures, and fixed the code rather than the tests: the bulk discount now starts at a quantity of ten and the tax is added on top of the discounted amount instead of replacing it. test/cart.test.js is untouched and the whole suite passes.

review.description: A shop cart whose test suite fails from the first second: the discount threshold is off by one and the tax is applied as a multiplier instead of a surcharge. Nothing states what is wrong, so the agent has to run the tests, read them and repair the code.
